items.question: Since Mr. Park has worked in ------ accounting and marketing, he will bring much-needed experience to Mr. Lee's team.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“both”代入题干后为“Since Mr. Park has worked in both accounting and marketing, he will bring much-needed experience to Mr. Lee's team.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：A（both）。
